cloud_card.queued: Processing your cloud card request in the background. Results will be sent privately; ordinary rolls are unaffected.
cloud_card.usage:
Cloud services .cloud (private chat only)
.cloud auth [write] // request account authorization; read-only unless write is given
.cloud confirm // confirm here after approving with the code on the web page
.cloud status // show the current authorization state
.cloud logout // clear the authorization stored on this machine
.cloud list // list your cloud cards
.cloud pull <cloud card ID> [local name] // pull a cloud card to this machine
.cloud push <local card> // upload a local card for the first time
.cloud sync <local card> // submit against the revision last synchronized
One authorization covers both: cloud cards and the real-QQ check share the same token. Nothing synchronizes on its own.
cloud_card.private_only: Use .cloud in your own private chat with this bot. Proxy authorization/synchronization is not allowed.
cloud_card.no_adapter: Use a real, connected platform private chat for cloud cards.
cloud_card.no_key: This adapter needs its verified BDC dice API key (heart_api_key). An unverified heartbeat key is not sufficient.
cloud_card.auth_code: Open {url} yourself and enter {code} within {seconds} seconds. Verify the bot and owner, and consent to write access only if wanted. Then send .cloud confirm here. Do not forward this code or approve someone else's request.
cloud_card.auth_sent: Authorization details were sent separately in private. After website approval, send .cloud confirm. If missing, use logout and authorize again.
cloud_card.authorized: Cloud card authorization is ready. Use .cloud list. Reauthorize after token expiry or a program restart.
cloud_card.authorized_bound: Cloud card authorization is ready and your QQ {{qq}} is verified: this account is now linked to that QQ, so cards and affinity carry over. Use .cloud list to see your cloud cards.
cloud_card.pending: Waiting for website approval. Approve, then send .cloud confirm. If you lost the code, logout and authorize again.
cloud_card.wait: Please wait before confirming or retrying the command.
cloud_card.denied: Authorization denied/cancelled. No cloud cards were accessed or changed.
cloud_card.expired: Authorization is missing, expired, revoked, or the bot key changed. Run .cloud auth again. Local cards are unaffected.
cloud_card.logout: Local tokens and pending codes cleared. Local/cloud cards remain. Revoke the bot in the account website's authorized applications to withdraw consent completely.
cloud_card.readonly: Required cloud card scope missing. Upload/sync requires .cloud auth write and explicit website approval.
cloud_card.busy: Another cloud card operation is running; retry shortly.
cloud_card.network: The cloud request could not be confirmed. Local cards are unchanged. After a first-upload error, check list before retrying to avoid duplicates.
cloud_card.bad_response: Unsupported/malformed cloud data or local sync-state storage failure. Existing local cards are not forcibly overwritten.
cloud_card.not_found: Cloud card not found or not owned by the authorized account.
cloud_card.conflict: Concurrent edits or expired merge base: sync stopped without overwriting either side. Pull CLOUD_ID NEW_LOCAL_NAME to inspect a separate cloud copy. No forced overwrite is attempted.
cloud_card.pulled: Cloud card {id} imported as '{name}'. Use .pc tag {name} in your game group; no automatic binding was changed.
cloud_card.local_changes: Local card exists, changed, is locked, or its link is invalid; overwrite refused. Back up and sync, or pull CLOUD_ID NEW_LOCAL_NAME into a separate card.
cloud_card.local_missing: Local card missing, unnamed, or ambiguous legacy duplicates exist. Check .pc list and resolve names first.
cloud_card.locked: Local read/write locks cannot be bypassed by cloud synchronization.
cloud_card.not_linked: No cloud link for this local card. Push it first, or pull a cloud card.
cloud_card.remote_saved: Cloud saved, but the local card changed/was locked during the request. New local edits are retained; review and sync again.

help.main:
Dice!Next Help
- Roll: .r .rh .rb/.rp .ww .dx
- Checks: .ra .rc .rav .sc(san) .en(grow)
- Cards: .st .pc (multi-card)
- Generate: .coc .dnd .name
- Decks: .deck .draw .gacha
- Fun: .jrrp .nn .set
- Admin: .bot .group .log .ob .dismiss .send
- Account: .bind (identity) .info (endpoints) .cloud (cloud services)
Type .help <cmd> for details (e.g. .help ra); .helpdoc lists all topics.
help.entry_missing: Help entry "{entry}" is not available yet; please check the docs.
help.unknown: No help found for "{topic}". Try .helpdoc for available topics.
help.ambiguous: "{topic}" matches several help topics: {list}. Please be more specific.

topic.rdx:
Double-Cross .rdx
.rdx <count>c<crit>[±final modifier] // legacy Dice compatibility alias, identical to .dx, e.g. .rdx 5c10+3
topic.r:
Roll .r
.r [expr] [reason] // roll dice, e.g. .r3d6+2 attack
.rh [expr] [reason] // hidden roll, the result is DM'd to you
N#<expr> // repeat the roll N times
A non-ASCII default-die reason may be attached without a space, e.g. .rd测试.
topic.rh:
Hidden .rh
.rh [expr] [reason] // hidden roll; the result is DM'd to you and the group only sees "<name> made a hidden roll"
.rah <skill> [rate] // hidden check, also DM'd, e.g. .rah Spot 60
.rch <skill> [rate] // same
House rules (.setcoc) and bonus/penalty dice still apply; nobody else sees the numbers.
topic.ra:
Check .ra
.ra <skill|attr> [rate] [reason] // COC check; reads the card if rate omitted
.ra(<outcome>)<rate> // preview the text for a specific result level, e.g. .ra(1)1, .ra(100)1
e.g. .ra spot / .ra str60.
topic.rx:
Psychology .rx
.rx @investigator [rate] // hidden Psychology roll for Keepers; the detailed result with success level is DM'd to you
Reads the target card's Psychology if rate omitted, default 10. The group only sees a non-spoiler receipt.
topic.rb:
Bonus/penalty .rb
.rb [N] [check] // bonus dice, keep the low tens, e.g. .rb spot
.rp [N] [check] // penalty dice, keep the high tens, e.g. .rp2 60
topic.sc:
Sanity .sc
.sc <success>/<fail> [san] // sanity check; auto-deducts SAN and saves to the card, e.g. .sc 1/1d6
topic.st:
Attributes .st
.st <attr><value> // set or modify attributes, e.g. .st str50 dex60
.st <attr>±<value> // adjust an attribute; dice allowed, e.g. hp-2, san+1d3
.st show // view the current card
.st clr // clear the card
.st del <attr> // delete one attribute
DND coins support pp/gp/ep/sp/cp and make change automatically when spending.
topic.pc:
Multi-card .pc
.pc new <name> // create a character card
.pc tag <name> // bind that card to the current group
.pc untag // remove the current binding
.pc rename <name> // rename the current card
.pc list // list your character cards
.pc del <name> // delete a character card
.pc @someone // view the card they bound in this group
.pc build // roll attributes from a template
.pc redo // roll attributes again
.pc lock <w|r> // lock writing or reading
.pc unlock <w|r> // remove the lock
topic.bind:
Cross-platform identity .bind
.cloud auth // authorize the account centre in private chat; links by the QQ verified at registration
.bind qq <real QQ> // run in a QQ Official window; links once the avatar check passes
.bind qq QQ-Official-<BotID>:<OpenID> // run in a OneBot window to link an official user
.bind qqgroup QQ-Official-<BotID>:<OpenID> // run inside the target group; owner or admin only
.bind discord <user ID> // run in a OneBot window
.bind kook <user ID> // run in a OneBot window
Before linking a platform account, the other side must have sent the bot a message there.
topic.info:
Window info .info
.info // show the type, identifier, working number and linked endpoints of this window
.info qq // look it up as a private-chat user
.info qqgroup // look it up as a group
A working number shown as a virtual number means no real QQ is linked yet; use .bind to link one.
topic.cloud:
Cloud services .cloud (private chat only)
.cloud auth [write] // request account authorization; read-only unless write is given
.cloud confirm // confirm here after approving with the code on the web page
.cloud status // show the current authorization state
.cloud logout // clear the authorization stored on this machine
.cloud list // list your cloud cards
.cloud pull <cloud card ID> [local name] // pull a cloud card to this machine
.cloud push <local card> // upload a local card for the first time
.cloud sync <local card> // submit against the revision last synchronized
One authorization covers both: cloud cards and the real-QQ check share the same token. Nothing synchronizes on its own.
topic.npc:
NPC .npc
.npc new <name> // create a group-shared character card
.npc list // list NPCs
.npc <name> st <attr><value> // set attributes, e.g. .npc Bob st str50
.npc <name> ra <skill> // roll as that NPC
.npc show <name> // view that NPC
.npc del <name> // delete that NPC
.npc clr <name> // clear that NPC's attributes
topic.dnd:
Chargen .dnd
.dnd [count] // generate DND stats, 4d6 keep highest 3
topic.deck:
Decks .deck
.deck // list available decks
.draw <deck> // draw one card
.gacha // pull
topic.jrrp:
Luck .jrrp
.jrrp // luck of the day, fixed per person per day
topic.bot:
Bot .bot
.bot // show version and status
.bot on // enable the bot in this group
.bot off // disable it here; only .bot still works
topic.group:
Group settings .group
.group [group ID] <state|info> // show this group's state or info
.group [group ID] +<term> // turn a term on, e.g. +禁用回复
.group [group ID] -<term> // turn a term off, e.g. -禁用help
.group [group ID] clr // clear this group's settings
.group all +<term> // apply to every group; owner or trust>=5, current bot account only
.group all -<term> // same conditions, turning the term off
topic.ob:
Observers .ob
.ob // show this help
.ob join // join as an observer
.ob list // list observers
.ob exit // stop observing
.ob on // allow observing here; group admin only
.ob off // disallow observing here; group admin only
.ob clr // clear the observer list; group admin or this session's GM
topic.send:
Message .send
.send <message> // forward a message to the Master
.send group <group id> <msg> // Master sends to a group
.send user <user id> <msg> // Master sends to a user
topic.log:
Session log .log
.log new [name] // create a log and start recording
.log on // resume recording
.log off // pause recording
.log end // finish and upload; sends a link and a group file
.log halt // finish without uploading
.log list // list logs
.log get [name] // upload again and get the link
.log del <name> // delete a log
.log stat [name] // show statistics
.log export [name] // send the group file only, no upload
.log type <txt|html> // set the group file format; group admin only
.log <time|timer> // timing
.log masterget <group> [name] // owner only; fetch a link across groups
topic.nn:
Nickname .nn
.nn <name> // set your display name in the bot
.nn // clear it
topic.set:
Default die .set
.set <sides> // set the default die, used by a bare .r
.set // reset it to 100
topic.ww:
Dice pool .ww
.ww <N> [success line] // WOD adding dice pool, legacy form, e.g. .ww 5 or .ww 5 7
.ww <N>a<add line>c<success line>[+extra successes] // extended form, e.g. .ww 10a8c7+2
Add line defaults to 10, success line to 8. Successful dice use circled numerals and every round is shown.
topic.dx:
Double-Cross .dx
.dx <count>c<crit>[±final modifier] // a d10 reaching the crit value explodes, e.g. .dx 5c10+3
.dx <count> <crit> // same, written as separate arguments
.rdx // legacy alias, identical to .dx
The modifier is applied once to the final tally. A DX-specific exploding check, not a plain roll.
topic.rav:
Opposed .rav
.rav <A> <B> // opposed check; both roll d100, compare success level first, then the roll on a tie
.rav <skill> @someone // oppose the @'d player
e.g. .rav fighting 60 / .rav spot @someone.
topic.ba:
BRP check .ba
.ba <skill|attr> [rate] [reason] // roll-under d100 check; reads the card if rate omitted
.ba <skill> @someone // roll on their behalf
Levels: critical ≤ skill/20, special ≤ skill/5, success ≤ skill, failure > skill, fumble 100 or 99 on a failure.
Supports N# multi-roll. e.g. .ba spot / .ba fighting60.
topic.bav:
Resistance .bav
.bav <active> <passive> // BRP resistance table; either side may be an attribute name (read from card) or a number
target% = 50 + (active − passive)×5; roll 1d100 ≤ target → active wins. e.g. .bav STR SIZ.
topic.en:
Growth .en
.en <skill> [value] [([fail-growth]/)success-growth] // COC skill growth; a d100 above the current value, or above 95, grows it and saves to the card
.en <skill> <skill> // batch growth, also written .en a|b
Growth starts with +/-, default +1d10.
topic.ti:
Madness .ti
.ti // draw a COC7 temporary madness symptom
.li // draw a COC7 indefinite madness symptom
Includes fear and mania subtables, for when a character loses sanity.
topic.setcoc:
House rule .setcoc
.setcoc <0-7> // set this group's COC check house rule; critical and fumble rulings differ
.setcoc show // show the current rule
.setcoc clr // clear it
topic.name:
Names .name
.name [cn|en|jp] [count] // random Chinese, English or Japanese names
.gn // alias of .name
topic.sleep:
Rest .sleep
.sleep // take a rest, returns a rest message
topic.mrrp:
Luck .mrrp
.mrrp // peek at tomorrow's luck, deterministic per user per day
topic.zrrp:
Luck .zrrp
.zrrp // look back at yesterday's luck, deterministic per user per day
topic.lang:
Language .lang
.lang // show the current reply language
.lang <简体|繁體|en|日本語> // switch the reply language
.lang clr // clear the override and fall back to the default
topic.favor:
Favor system
好感 // show {self}'s favor toward you and your title
好感排行 // show the favor ranking
群内好感排行 // show this group's favor ranking
.favor add [n] [@someone] // raise favor; requires master or trust >= 4
.favor grow [@someone] // raise it by the growth rule; same permission
.favor set <n> [@someone] // write the favor value directly; same permission
.favor clr [@someone] // clear the favor record; same permission
Higher favor grows slower.
topic.hiy:
Stats .hiy
.hiy // overall check stats
.hiy <skill> // that skill's rolls, successes, rate and level breakdown
topic.setsn:
Group card .setsn
.setsn <attrs...> // choose which attributes the group .sn card shows; up to 5, default hp san dex, owner or admin only
topic.sn:
Group card .sn
.sn [template] // set your own group card from a template
.sn off // clear your group card
Affected by the .setsn setting.
topic.ri:
Initiative .ri
.ri [±mod] [name] // roll d20+mod and join the initiative list
.init // show the initiative order
.init clr // clear the list
.init del <name> // remove an entry
topic.welcome:
Welcome message .welcome
.welcome <text> // set the join welcome; {at} is supported
.welcome show // view the current welcome
.welcome off // turn it off
topic.dismiss:
Leave .dismiss
.dismiss // make the bot leave this group; requires group admin or master
topic.rules:
Rules .rules
.rules <term> // look the term up in the group's default rule book
.rules <book>:<term> // look it up in a specific book, e.g. .rules coc:fumble
.ruleset <book> // set the group's default rule book
topic.plugin:
Plugins .plugin
.plugin list // list plugins and their per-group state
.plugin on <name> // enable one plugin in this group
.plugin off <name> // disable one plugin in this group
.plugin all <on|off> // toggle them all
Group owners and admins only.
topic.game:
Game table .game
.game new <name> // create a table; the creator becomes GM
.game open <16-char code> // attach this group to the same table, GM only
.game join // take a seat
.game exit // leave the table
.game master // claim GM, or list current GMs
.game state // show the table state
.game set <var> <value> // set a table variable, GM only
.game call // call all players, GM only
.game kick <QQ> // remove someone from the table, GM only
.game close // close this group's area
.game over // end the game
.game rou <faces>[*copies] // roulette dice, GM only
.game rou <hist|reset|clr> // show, restore or clear the roulette record

pc.usage:
